name: coworkingview
abstract: Snapshot of the CoworkingView flexible-office price index
description: Pure SQL PostgreSQL extension that installs a snapshot of the CoworkingView Price Index, the open dataset of median flexible-office prices by city and product. The snapshot covers flex desks, fixed desks, private offices, day passes and meeting rooms, and provides coworkingview_rate(city) plus a view over the rows. Price Index figures are CC BY 4.0. The extension code is MIT.
